item.title: Why Ask the Four Questions Alone? Pesah and the Freedom to Ask | Shiurim & Talks
item.description:
Is the Seder a night of asking even for someone alone? Asking questions is itself the experience of freedom, because a person's freedom lies in the mind, which Pharaoh tried to take. The red wine and white massah stand for emotion and intellect, and communities differ in detail but share a core.

item.title: Rambam and Superstitions | Shiurim & Talks
item.description:
A Gemara says a woman whose two husbands died may not marry a third, yet the Rambam calls the concern superstition and imagination and lets her remarry. Through five examples, from ruah raah and a warning from a demon to names inside a mezuzah and ayin hara, the shiur shows how the Rambam reads such passages rationally and why he saw charms and spirits as crutches that pull us away from God.
